billing_mode: explicit API key; no ChatGPT subscription fallback

local_computation.runtimes: same locally available offline Python/Sage images and limits as SIGMA

output_cap_rationale: Smallest proposed cap that leaves high-reasoning generation room beyond the structured public answer; 1,024 can be consumed substantially by non-visible reasoning. Clipping remains incomplete and cannot be ruled out without live inference.
input_reservation: UTF-8 byte length of exact serialized request body + 8192 tokens per call
unknown_or_inflight_call: retain the full input/output/cost reservation and block later calls; do not retry
clipped_max_output_tokens: preserve partial output and usage; arm status incomplete; no correctness penalty; no retry
arm_order: select SIGMA-first or baseline-first from a recorded fair coin toss immediately before execution
